name: War of the Ancients
summary: As Queen Azshara and her Highborne opened the Well of Eternity, the Burning Legion entered Azeroth. Malfurion Stormrage, Illidan, and Tyrande Whisperwind led the resistance that drove the demons back. The Well's destruction brought the Great Sundering, breaking ancient Kalimdor and changing the world.

sections.title: The Highborne's Folly
sections.body:
At the height of the ancient Kaldorei Empire, Queen Azshara and her Highborne sorcerers drew deeply on the Well of Eternity's arcane power. Their spells reached into the Great Dark Beyond and caught the notice of Sargeras, master of the Burning Legion. He promised power and perfection. Then Azshara and her advisor Xavius opened a rift within the Well.

FelHounds, felguard, doomguard, and monstrous commanders poured into Zin-Azshari. They slaughtered those who were not Highborne and began a crusade to purge the world of life.

sections.title: The Kaldorei Resistance
sections.body: Night elves beyond the Highborne caste rose against the slaughter. Three remarkable leaders gathered the resistance: Malfurion Stormrage, the first mortal druid; Tyrande Whisperwind, a devoted priestess of Elune; and Illidan, Malfurion's gifted brother. Together, they brought common night elves to a desperate frontline against the Legion's onslaught.

sections.title: The Price of Victory
sections.body:
The war grew to world-shattering proportions when Cenarius rallied the ancient Wild Gods and dragonflights to the fight. To keep Sargeras from setting foot on Azeroth, Malfurion and the resistance tried to collapse the portal over the Well of Eternity. Their desperate gambit cast the demonic host back into the Twisting Nether, but the strain proved too great.

The Well violently imploded and triggered the Great Sundering. Kalimdor broke into separate continents, the world's center flooded to form the Great Sea, and Kaldorei culture changed forever.

faq.q: What caused the War of the Ancients?
aliases: who caused the war of the ancients
faq.answer: Queen Azshara and her Highborne sorcerers drew on the Well of Eternity's arcane power. Their spells reached across the cosmos and drew the dark titan Sargeras. He persuaded the Highborne to open a gateway in the Well so the Burning Legion could enter Azeroth.

The Great Sundering was the cataclysm that ended the war. To keep Sargeras from entering the world, the resistance collapsed the portal inside the Well of Eternity. The Well imploded, tearing Kalimdor's single supercontinent into separate landmasses and forming the Great Sea.

faq.q: Who led the mortal forces against the Legion?
faq.answer: Malfurion Stormrage, his brother Illidan, and the priestess Tyrande Whisperwind rallied the night elves against Azshara and the Legion. The demigod Cenarius brought the ancient spirits of the wild to their side.

faq.q: Did other races fight alongside the night elves?
aliases: tauren in war of the ancients
faq.answer: Yes. The great dragonflights joined the struggle, and Cenarius led his wild brethren into battle beside the night elves against the demonic invasion.

faq.q: What happened to Queen Azshara during the war?
faq.answer: Queen Azshara stayed in her palace at Zin-Azshari until the bitter end, obsessed with bringing Sargeras into Azeroth. When the Well imploded and the oceans swallowed the capital, the queen and her surviving Highborne loyalists sank into the churning depths.

faq.q: Why is arcane magic mistrusted by night elves today?
aliases: why do night elves hate mages
faq.answer: The Kaldorei saw the Highborne's unchecked hunger for arcane magic summon the Burning Legion and destroy ancient Kalimdor. Afterward, the night elves outlawed arcane sorcery and turned to druidism and faith in Elune to protect their lands.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the war behind your people's deep mistrust of arcane magic, reverence for Cenarius, and enduring leadership under Malfurion and Tyrande.
As a druid, you inherit a path born in this conflict. Malfurion Stormrage learned the ways of the wild from Cenarius and showed that nature's power could defeat cosmic ruin.
As a mage, you know the Highborne's reckless arrogance is a warning across Azeroth about the dangers of unchecked arcane power.
As a tauren, you can honor Cenarius and the demigods of the wild. Their forest spirits fought the Legion beside the night elves ten thousand years ago.
As a priest, you follow a tradition shaped by Tyrande Whisperwind. Her mastery of Elune's grace brought the Priesthood of the Moon to the heart of night elven military and civic leadership.
